qualitative_triggers: disagreement repeatedly centers on unavoidable causal wording
removing causal interpretation makes L3 unusable
L4 cannot be authored without nearly specifying the repair
collapse_rule.note: Threshold is deliberately unchanged from V1. It was registered before any review existed and must not be adjusted after results are seen.

conservative_packet_policy.note: Approval is not a majority vote. Any one of these findings from either reviewer blocks scheduling.

preregistered_confound_check.reason: The corpus is cumulative, so statement count correlates with level. High exact-level agreement could reflect counting rather than reading.
preregistered_confound_check.procedure: Before interpreting exact-level agreement, score a classifier that uses statement count alone, fitted on the disclosed per-level count table. Report reviewer agreement alongside that baseline.
preregistered_confound_check.interpretation_rule: If reviewer exact-level agreement does not clearly exceed the count-only baseline, exact-level agreement must not be reported as evidence of semantic separability.

seed_disclosure.note: The ordering seed is recorded in the V2 freeze. It is never included in a reviewer export.
